uncited: **Octree Construction/Update:** As macro blocks arrive, the octree is incrementally updated.
**Cut Plane Optimization:** If a cut plane is defined, start the ray at the cut plane intersection instead of the dataset boundary.
**Empty Space Skipping:** Use the octree to skip over transparent regions.
**Alpha Cutoff:** Accumulate opacity along the ray.
- **Transparent Macros:** If the octree tagging is inaccurate, skipping may lead to visual artifacts.
- **Adaptive Refinement:** Choosing the dissimilarity threshold too low may lead to excessive ray casting; too high may miss details.
Adaptive ray casting improves quality in complex regions without uniform overhead.
